lead: A hand-rolled tool's `--help` can be wrong or run the tool instead, and `loop.py` reads a non-zero exit on it as a broken script.
body: The argparse tools print their flags for free, while a hand-rolled parser can omit a flag or ignore `--help` and run its full inventory, hiding what the script takes from any session that asks. `loop.py`'s `tools_still_load` probes every changed `tools/*.py` with `--help`, so a new hand-rolled tool must print its docstring's flag block and exit 0.
